summary: Customer requests loan repayment schedule, agent provides resolution.

intents.keywords: हेलो मैं मेघा सिंह मेरी लोन का पुनर ... मुझे शेड्यूल नहीं मिला।

issues.issue: Customer did not receive the loan repayment schedule.

intents.actions of agent: Agent checked and confirmed the schedule was sent to the registered email and offered to resend it.
intents.Process Request: Resending the repayment schedule via email.
intents.resolution: Agent resent the loan repayment schedule to the customer's registered email address.

intents.keywords: क्या इस फिजिकल कॉपी में मिल सकता है?
intents.actions of agent: Agent informed the customer that they can obtain a physical copy from the branch.
intents.resolution: Customer can get the physical copy from the branch.
